data: For fiscal 2023, which ended on September 30, 2023, Apple reported total net sales of about $383.3 billion, down roughly 2.8% from $394.3 billion in fiscal 2022. Net income was about $97.0 billion ($96,995 million), compared with $99.8 billion the year before, a decline of roughly 2.8%, and diluted earnings per share came to $6.13. Total assets on the balance sheet at the end of fiscal 2023 were about $352.6 billion ($352,583 million), slightly above the $352.8 billion figure… more precisely, essentially flat versus the roughly $352.8 billion reported at the end of fiscal 2022. These figures come from Apple's fiscal 2023 Form 10-K, which you may want to check for exact line items.
